text.p: Tropical Depression 17P is a weak system with top winds near 25-30 mph. It is in the Samoa Islands at this time drifting slowly to the west. This track will continue until the system dissipates by 12-24 hours. Heavy showers and squalls may continue to cause some flash flooding through smaller islands during this time The threat to shipping from this system is minimal.

Tropical Cyclone 18S, centered in the southern Indian Ocean near 24s/85e, is moving southwest at 16 mph. Top winds are 45 mph and will continue to weaken this period. This system will likely be dissipated by 24-36 hours. This system is only a threat to shipping and this threat will diminish with time.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
